-->
:::{#exm-mallows-cp}
#### Mallows' $C_p$ of nested `mtcars` models

This example computes @def-mallows-cp for the four models of @exm-adjusted-r-squared.
The [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) $\est{\varpar}$ of the noise variance is the residual variance of the model with all four predictors,
`r round(mtcars_full_sigma2, 2)`.

```{r}
#| label: mallows-cp-mtcars
mtcars_cp <- vapply(
  seq_along(mtcars_fits),
  \(k) {
    rss <- sum(resid(mtcars_fits[[k]])^2)
    (rss + 2 * k * mtcars_full_sigma2) / nrow(mtcars)
  },
  numeric(1)
)
tibble::tibble(predictors = 1:4, cp = mtcars_cp)
```

The model with `r which.min(mtcars_cp)` predictors has the smallest $C_p$.

:::
